**Soporte ≥10** — brechas cuya enzima ex: **Support ≥10** — gaps whose enzyme exists in 10 or more of the 400 reference genomes. High support indicates that the pathway is common and that the gene is probably there, even if we do not detect it.
Esta aplicación lee el ADN de una bacter: This application reads the DNA of a bacterium and tells you which genes it has, which chemical reactions it can perform and what it lacks to live. Everything runs on your computer: nothing is sent to the internet.
Una **TU** (unidad de transcripción) es: A **TU** (transcription unit) is a message copied from a promoter. The same operon can have several internal promoters, and that is why it is copied in different pieces depending on the situation.
Ventana del genoma con sus pistas apilad: A window of the genome with its tracks stacked. The **axis is shared**: each position in bp lines up across all tracks, and each track has its own band so they do not overlap. Tick the ones you want to see.
Porcentaje del genoma que quedó cubierto: Percentage of the genome that was covered by some annotation. A high value means we understood most of it; a low value indicates many unknown stretches, not that the analysis failed.
Filtra por nivel de confianza. `validate: Filter by confidence level. `validated` = two independent methods agree; `consensus` = one method with support; `candidate` = a single piece of evidence; `anomalous` = the methods contradict each other.
**ORFs no anotados** — busca posibles ge: **Unannotated ORFs** — looks for possible genes in the gaps between known genes. The idea: if a bacterium needs an enzyme and we cannot find it, it may be hidden in a stretch that nobody annotated.
Marcas de **transcripción**: dónde empie: **Transcription** marks: where the RNA starts (TSS) and where it ends (TTS). The solid ones are curated; the faded ones come from high-throughput work. It is the data that decides the borders when it exists.
**CDS (genes que producen proteína)** —: **CDS (genes that produce protein)** — finds the DNA stretches that start with a start codon, end at a stop codon and are translated into a protein. Without this there is nothing else to analyze.
Estados: `validated` dos métodos coincid: Statuses: `validated` two methods agree · `consensus` they agree without external truth · `lineage_specific` the lineage lacks the usual marker · `anomalous` they disagree · `unresolved` no candidate.
**ΔG** (energía libre de plegamiento, en: **ΔG** (folding free energy, in kcal/mol) — how much energy is released when the loop forms. A large negative value indicates a stable structure; the more negative it is, the harder it is to undo.

Piloto: las hélices transmembrana y el p: Pilot: transmembrane helices and the signal peptide are estimated with simple hydrophobicity rules, not with the specialized predictors. Most rows are left at low confidence on purpose.
Un **cierre** es una propuesta de soluci: A **closure** is a proposed solution for a gap: a protein from the genome that could be the missing enzyme. Each closure says which domain it has, which gene it is in and how solid the evidence is.
Estas no son predicciones estadísticas:: These are not statistical predictions: they are **written rules** that decide, between each two genes, whether they continue in the same message or start a new one. Each decision shows its reason, so you can discuss it.
Límites: el ANI se calcula con fastANI,: Limits: ANI is computed with fastANI, without the full GTDB-Tk workflow; in several genomes there is no independent reference; and 95% is not a universal border. «Provisional» is not a definitive truth.
Un cierre `candidate` no es `confirmed`:: A `candidate` closure is not `confirmed`: it means «we found a protein that fits», not «we proved that it performs that reaction». Energy is estimated under standard conditions (pH 7, ionic strength 0.1 M, 25 °C).
Las alternativas de estructura de esta s: The structure alternatives in this section **use ESMFold**. ESMFold predicts a 3D structure from the sequence. A high-confidence structure **does not confirm** function, substrate or gap closure.
Una **cadena** es un camino de reaccione: A **chain** is a path of reactions that connects a molecule that is left over with another that is missing. If the bacterium cannot do one step, it may reach the same result by another path: that is an alternative route.
Triaje de las anomalías: se añadió una c: Triage of the anomalies: an extra check was added (GC bias and DnaA boxes). That check is right 57% of the time in already validated genomes, so it **does not reclassify on its own**: it only leaves the evidence in view.
Análisis ya calculado de los 400 genomas: Already computed analysis of the project's 400 genomes. Each tab answers a different question; start with «Gaps» if you want to know what a bacterium lacks, and with «Operons» if you are interested in how its genes are organized.
Límites: contexto = vecino anotado/same: Limits: context = annotated neighbor/same strand, not the whole operon; 400-genome co-occurrence added; refs without a eukaryotic filter; score is not a probability. AFDB only covers known homologs; the exact ORF requires ESMFold/ColabFold.
Estas enzimas tocan los mismos metabolit: These enzymes touch the same metabolites, so they probably take part in the same pathway. Being adjacent in the DNA is a **suspicion** of a metabolic operon. It is not proof: there are adjacent pathways that are not operons and operons without an associated pathway.
Estos datos vienen precalculados para lo: These data come precomputed for the project's genomes. The source does not include the contig or the strand, so the coordinates are relative to the whole genome. For an uploaded genome, specific tools that are not integrated would be needed.
**Completitud** es qué fracción de las r: **Completeness** is what fraction of a pathway's reactions is present in the genome. If a pathway has 10 steps and we find 7, its completeness is 0.7. It is not the same as essentiality: an incomplete pathway can work if the cell imports the product.
El **origen de replicación** (oriC) es e: The **replication origin** (oriC) is the point in the DNA where genome copying starts. Locating it matters because genes near the origin are copied more times and are usually more active. It is searched with several independent methods and we state which ones agree.
Genes **contiguos** cuyas enzimas partic: **Adjacent** genes whose enzymes take part in the **same reaction network** (they share metabolites). It is a cheap clue of a metabolic operon: many adjacent pathways are not operons and many operons have no associated pathway. It is marked as a **suspicion**, never as a fact.
Un **catálogo** es una lista ordenada. A: A **catalog** is an ordered list. Here we group metabolic holes by pathway type. A **hole** (or gap) is a chemical step that the bacterium needs but for which we do not find the enzyme: like a recipe that is missing an ingredient and you do not know which one.
No todas las brechas son «falta una enzi: Not all gaps are «a missing enzyme». Some are explained because the molecule comes in from outside, others because the gene exists but is mapped wrong, and others because the pathway uses a shortcut. Here they are grouped by pathway family and an explanation and a next step are proposed.
La **membrana** es la piel de la bacteri: The **membrane** is the skin of the bacterium: a layer of fat that separates the inside from the outside. Here we annotate the proteins that live in it or cross it: hydrophobic parts (TM), shipping signals (signal peptide), lipoproteins, transporters and secretion systems.
**Taxonomía** es ordenar la vida por par: **Taxonomy** is ordering life by relatedness. To know which species a genome is, we compare its DNA with reference genomes and compute the **ANI** (average nucleotide identity): the percentage of match between two genomes. Above 95% it is usually the same species.
Un **operón** es un grupo de genes que s: An **operon** is a group of genes that are read together, like a single instruction. They share a switch (the **promoter**) and are copied into one and the same message. This lets the bacterium turn on several genes at once. Here you see each piece we know of each operon of *E. coli* K-12.

A veces el gen está, pero la reacción no: Sometimes the gene is there, but the reaction does not appear in the network. That is called a **mapping gap**: the enzyme exists and does the job, but our system did not connect it with the right reaction. Here we look for the closest homolog in reference genomes to decide whether the gene really exists.
Una **brecha** es una molécula que la ba: A **gap** is a molecule that the bacterium should be able to make (because other pathways need it) but for which the enzyme does not appear. The job is to explain each gap: is the gene really missing, is it hidden, or does the bacterium get the molecule from outside? Each gap declares its sources so that you can judge.
Aquí se anotan los elementos que se muev: Here we annotate the elements that move or defend the bacterium: **mobile elements** (pieces of DNA that copy themselves and paste elsewhere), **prophages** (bacterial viruses asleep inside the genome), **defense systems**, **CRISPR** (the immune system of the bacterium), **AMR** (antibiotic resistance genes) and **virulence** (ability to cause damage).
Una **horquilla** es un pliegue del ARN:: A **hairpin** is a fold in the RNA: the molecule bends over itself and forms a loop, like a shoelace that curls up. That loop can slow down the machine that copies the DNA and make it stop. It is a **clue**, not a proof: one in five real hairpins cuts in the middle of an operon (attenuation), and some terminations do not use a hairpin at all.
- **Anotación incompleta**: hay ORF/domi:
- **Incomplete annotation**: there is an ORF/domain, but the enzyme is not named.
- **Divergent domain**: weak homology or partial domain.
- **Transport/import**: the metabolite can come in; it is not synthesized.
- **Spontaneous**: the reaction happens without an enzyme.
- **Multifunctional/promiscuous**: another enzyme covers the reaction.
- **Alternative pathway**: it is reached by another route.
- **Gene loss/auxotrophy**: the gene is not there; it depends on the medium/host.
- **KEGG/Rhea definition**: reaction misassigned or incomplete.
- **No bacterial reference**: Rhea only has a eukaryotic producer; it is not absence.
- **False positive**: the hole is not real.
